crossCutting.src/__tests__/_support: Builders and stubs shared by tests across folders.
crossCutting.src/__tests__/fixtures: Test data, one folder per domain.
crossCutting.src/__tests__/repo: Repository hygiene and guard checks that read the whole tree.
crossCutting.src/__tests__/scripts: Tests of the root scripts/ toolchain and the security/ policy that ship in the public snapshot; scripts/__tests__/ is withheld from it.
crossCutting.src/__tests__/e2e: Browser journeys through the whole app.
crossCutting.src/__tests__/perf: Timing benches of the operation layer.

files.src/__tests__/boot-guard.test.ts: Exercises public/boot-guard.js inside the real index.html, the page the src root entries boot in; no src folder holds either file.
